tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the Zest Planche catalog; best sellers of the moment come first.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full product sheet: composition, allergens, ordering conditions, variants and prices (cents).

tools.name: build_basket
tools.description: Validate and price a basket, and get the link that opens zestplanche.com with it in the cart. Quantities below a product's minimum are raised to it and reported in `issues`.

tools.name: open_shop
tools.description: Show the interactive Zest Planche shop, optionally pre-filled with a suggested basket. The user browses products, adjusts quantities and checks out on zestplanche.com.

tools.name: shop_catalog
tools.description: Catalog payload for the shop view.
